description: This file defines the NotePreviewFragment class for the Android application, responsible for rendering and managing the preview of a note, handling user interactions, refreshing content, and applying branding.

classes.name: NotePreviewFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a preview of a note, handles user interactions, refresh actions, and applies branding customization.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares and adjusts the options menu, showing edit options while hiding preview options.

methods.name: getScrollView
methods.description: Returns the ScrollView used in this fragment.

methods.name: scrollToY
methods.description: Scrolls the view to the specified Y position.

methods.name: getSearchNextButton
methods.description: Returns the button for navigating to the next search result.

methods.name: getSearchPrevButton
methods.description: Returns the button for navigating to the previous search result.

methods.name: getDirectEditingButton
methods.description: Returns the button for direct editing of the note.

methods.name: getNormalEditButton
methods.description: Returns the button for normal editing mode.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Provides the layout of the note for rendering.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment view and initializes view binding.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up preferences, link handlers, and display settings after activity creation.

methods.name: onNoteLoaded
methods.description: Loads the note content into the view and sets up observers for content changes.

methods.name: registerInternalNoteLinkHandler
methods.description: Sets up click callback for internal note links for navigation.

methods.name: colorWithText
methods.description: Highlights text within the note with a specified color.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the current content of the note.

methods.name: onRefresh
methods.description: Handles pull-to-refresh action; attempts to sync note content from server.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding colors and configurations to the note view.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the fragment with specific note and account IDs.
